name: Jefferson Creek Campground
evidence: Esri with 16 rec.gov site points plotted: RV sites on a conifer bench 70-100 m from Jefferson Creek's beaver-pond channel (well under 30 m, so no river value); rec.gov photos of all RV sites but 009 (none exists) show forest, no water.

name: Kelly Flats Campground
evidence: Esri + NAIP at 40.6809,-105.4837: drive-in gravel pad ~15-20 m from the Poudre bank past a thin willow fringe; channel 28-33 m measured at the sites. FS photos: sites 19/23 show no water, walk-in 17 does and does not count. No site map or catalog; pad's number unknown.

name: Lodgepole Campground (Taylor River)
evidence: Esri with rec.gov site points: all RV sites south of paved CR 742, 55-65 m from the ~30-35 m Taylor River past the road, fishing lot and bank treeline, in conifers on level ground (3DEP). Stored pads are the day-use lot. No site photos exist, so no view confirmed; default down.

name: Lake Fork Campground (Conejos River)
evidence: NAIP + Esri with rec.gov points: Conejos channel 12-19 m at the sites, so creekside by size. RV sites 014, 015 (50/70 ft) ~20-30 m across open grass, thin fringe; rec.gov tags 011, 012, 014, 015, 017 Riverfront; site 017 photo shows the water.

name: Lake Irwin Campground
evidence: Esri + NAIP with rec.gov points: RV site 004 only (30 ft, walk-up, no photo) ~45 m to the high-water edge over open, footpath-only ground; 3DEP 6 m gentle fall, no bluff. Others 60 m+ behind trees; site 002 photo shows the lake past trees.

name: Lost Lake Campground
evidence: Esri + NAIP at 38.8698,-107.2057: RV pull-outs on the north side of the campground road, ~25 m from the slough with the road between (loop-road rule), open grass view. Pull-ins south of the road unproven as numbered sites; no FS site map found; reviews only leads.

name: Matchless Campground
evidence: NAIP + Esri at 39.2590,-106.3592: upper lot edge ~40 m from the beach top through a continuous conifer band, 3DEP ~7 m above it, so not on-water; lower lot 70 m+; not below the dam. No site map or photos; Campendium 2020 site 15 'faced the lake', others split, so view is thin.

name: May Queen Campground
evidence: NAIP + Esri with rec.gov points: nearest RV site 022 ~80 m from Turquoise Lake across road and day-use parking; creek 100 m+ past the outer road and woods. rec.gov photo of site 022 shows the lake; other RV site photos do not.
